newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil sees lower reserves, production.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil sees lower reserves, production.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said early Monday that it expects to operate at a reduced level of reserves, production and cash flow for an interim period in the wake of its sale of all 14 million shares of common stock it holds in Patina Oil & Gas Corp.

"In the second quarter of 1997, for example, our total production of approximately 41,000 BOE per day consisted of approximately 18,000 BOE per day from Patina and 23,000 BOE per day from our ongoing core properties," Snyder Chairman John Snyder said in a statement.
"Fortunately, production from our core properties is growing dramatically in both the Rocky Mountains and in the Gulf of Mexico as a result of development programs currently under way."
